interpretation: Single free-running game per configuration and single fixed replay sequence; no confidence interval or broad quality claim.
Padra native K3 with Q8 head and K4 MTP draft differs from llama.cpp IQ4_XS with N-gram speculation; this is not an equal-quantization engine comparison.
llama.cpp fit may place tensors on CPU; read saved placement flags/logs. Padra uses the admitted GPU profile.
Free-running agents see different tool results/trajectories. Same task/Pi/settings does not imply byte-identical later requests.
Identical fixed HTTP bodies do not guarantee identical rendered token IDs: Padra and llama.cpp report slightly different prompt lengths on follow-ups.
Completed-response usage excludes failed turns without a final SSE usage frame; server counters include generation work from these turns.
Fresh prefill TPS divides newly evaluated tokens by prefill seconds. Effective total input throughput includes cached tokens and is a distinct metric.
Decode TPS uses completion_tokens minus one because the first token comes from final prefill logits.
Agent exit/completion and speed alone do not establish playable output; browser evaluation is separate.
